name: Community — MiniMax H3 Emotion TTS Lip-Sync
author: T8mars + IndexTeam + larryvrh
description:
Type the line, pick the mood, get the character saying it. IndexTTS 2.5 speaks your quoted dialogue in the voice you supply, with the emotion you name, and MiniMax H3 lip-syncs the reference character to that speech in one generation.

HOW TO USE IT
1. AUDIO SLOT = a VOICE SAMPLE, 3-10 s of clean speech from the voice you want. It is cloned, not lip-synced. Any language sample works; the spoken line is English.
2. REFERENCE IMAGES = the character(s), up to nine, exactly like the Lip-Sync preset.
3. PROMPT = a normal H3 shot description that contains the line in double quotes. The first "quoted" run of text is what gets spoken, e.g.: A woman in a leather jacket at a microphone, hard blue key light, looks into the camera and says "You are leaving tomorrow, and nobody told me." Static shot.
4. EMOTION (optional) = an [emotion: ...] tag anywhere in the prompt, in plain words: [emotion: angry, clipped], [emotion: sad and tired], [emotion: bright and happy]. The tag is removed from the prompt before H3 sees it. Without a tag the emotion is copied from the voice sample.

The preset prepends the <Audio 1>: fully_copy binding to your prompt automatically. That line is what makes H3 reproduce the speech instead of keeping only the timbre and inventing its own words - three runs without it did exactly that. Do not write your own <Audio 1> line.

Verified 2026-09-02 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, SimpliGen 1.58.2 / engine ComfyUI 0.34.2: a 6 s angry line at 864x480 with one reference image - TTS_TIME - and the output transcribes word-perfect against the written line, with the mouth on the words and the emotion in the delivery.

WHAT TO EXPECT. The spoken line is trimmed to the shot length; a line longer than the duration is cut, a shorter one leaves H3 to fill the rest with room tone and a closed mouth. Duration default 6 s. Keep lines to one or two sentences per shot. IndexTTS takes 3-5 s per line plus a one-time model load; the H3 part is the Lip-Sync preset's Turbo chain, 6 steps.

DEPENDENCIES, READ BEFORE INSTALLING. Adds the comfyui-indextts25-T8 custom node (pinned) and 7.7 GB of IndexTTS 2.5 weights into the engine's models/TTS folder. The node pins transformers below 5 and its install DOWNGRADES the engine's transformers (5.15.1 -> 4.57.x). SimpliGen's maintainer has confirmed this is allowed and sticks across engine updates; every other shipped pack has been re-verified against it, but any future pack that pins transformers 5 will conflict with this one in the shared engine. If a later IndexTTS node starts on the first run but cannot find its weights, restart SimpliGen once: the models/TTS folder is registered at engine start.

video.displayModel: IndexTTS 2.5 + MiniMax H3 Reference (pruned int8) + Turbo LoRA

extensions.name: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo
extensions.description: Turbo LoRA loader node + dual-schedule sampler node (required - the workflow will fail to load without it)

extensions.name: comfyui-indextts25-T8
extensions.description: IndexTTS 2.5 text-to-speech nodes (T8mars). Its requirements.txt pins transformers<5 and WILL downgrade the engine's transformers on install; the SimpliGen maintainer confirmed such pins are allowed and persist.

requirements.notes: Everything the Lip-Sync preset needs plus the IndexTTS 2.5 weights (7.7 GB, 26 files into models/TTS/IndexTTS-2.5, from t8star's Comfy mirror at a pinned revision) and the comfyui-indextts25-T8 node. The node downgrades the engine's transformers to the 4.5x line; confirmed allowed and persistent by SimpliGen's maintainer (2026-09-02). Verified 2026-09-02 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, SimpliGen 1.58.2 / engine ComfyUI 0.34.2: a 6 s angry line at 864x480 with one reference image - TTS_TIME - and the output transcribes word-perfect against the written line, with the mouth on the words and the emotion in the delivery. Emotion vector, text and reference-audio modes were all verified in a vanilla ComfyUI test the same day; this preset uses text mode when an [emotion] tag is present and speaker mode (emotion taken from the voice sample) otherwise. IndexTTS-2.5 model licence: IndexTeam, see the DISCLAIMER in the model repo; the node sets accept_model_license for you.
